messages:
sara: quick thread - proposing a lightweight proxy preflight to assert residency before accepting writes in active-active. preflight + cached verdict, demote flow when owner rejects.
mike: concern: sync preflight = latency. only do sync for first-write-in-session or after lease-swap; cache TTL per-tenant.
juan: what's the control-plane signal? a single small RPC from edge proxy?
sara: yep: GET /v1/tenancy/{t}/residency-check -> {allowed:[...], policy: "reject"|"demote_local"|"queue", ttl:secs}. edge caches.
anna: how to avoid stale verdicts during rapid ownership changes? fallback rules?
mike: on cache-miss do RPC. on 409/residency-reject: proxy returns RESIDENCY_VIOLATION + X-Residency-Hint owner-region and asynchronously notifies owner region to re-evaluate.
juan: demote_local is risky for compliance. must be opt-in per-tenant. default should be reject.
legal-bot: note: demote_local on EU data requires explicit documented consent. demote_local must be gated by signed_contract flag in tenancy metadata.
sara: agreed. propose tenancy flag residency_failover: ["reject","demote_local","queue_for_owner"] default: reject for regulated tenants.
anna: telemetry we need: preflight_latency, preflight_cache_hit_rate, demote_events, residency_reject_count. expose as per-tenant metrics.
mike: implementation: small cache per-edge with LRU + TTL; heavy-traffic tenants pin entries. consider bloom-filter optimization for allowed-region sets to reduce control-plane calls.
juan: memory is a constraint on edge proxies. use TTL + global cap and eviction prioritized by traffic. also include a fast-path O(1) index in control-plane for hot tenants.
sara: rollout plan: 1) admin opt-in tenants only 2) implement control-plane residency-check API + edge cache 3) add demote flag opt-in 4) collect telemetry 5) evaluate cost/latency and legal sign-offs.
mike: sample pseudo: 
GET /v1/tenancy/:t/residency-check -> 200 {policy:"reject", allowed:["eu"], ttl:3600}
if cache.miss: call control-plane
if verdict.reject and tenant.policy=="demote_local" and tenant.signed_contract: accept write with tag "demoted_local" else return 403 + header X-Residency-Hint:owner=eu

juan: can we reuse X-Redwood-Residency header to minimize SDK work? error codes should be stable: RESIDENCY_VIOLATION and hint header.
sara: yes we can piggyback, but control-plane API still required. SDK changes limited to recognizing new error code.
legal-bot: record KMS key origin and consent version on demote_local events for audit trails.
anna: long-term refactor: merge tenancy residency metadata + lease/ownership table into single fast lookup index so preflight is O(1). avoids control-plane fanout.
mike: reviewers? I'll take perf and cache design. juan take security/compliance. anna take telemetry. sara will author the RFC follow-up.
sara: thanks all. I'll draft the RFC patch with API schema, proxy cache eviction rules, per-tenant flags, and telemetry panels. will ping reviewers when ready.
